newsitem.title: USA: Acme Electric to sell aerospace unit assets.
newsitem.headline: Acme Electric to sell aerospace unit assets.

text.p: Acme Electric Corp said Tuesday that it has agreed to sell the assets of its aerospace unit for about $6 million to Ultra Force Battery Co Inc, a new subsidiary of BAT International Inc.
Acme said the agreement also provides for licensing its battery-related technologies for electric vehicle and other markets.
The company said closing should occur in 90 days if all contingencies are met.
Acme designs and makes power conversion equipment for electronic and electrical systems. BAT International of Burbank, California, makes electric vehicle and bicycles.
